allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Grant of 9,500 Employee Stock Options to the Eligible Employees under Aeroflex IndustriesLimited Employee Stock Options Plan 2024 as approved by Nomination Remuneration andCompensation Committee of the Company.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Aeroflex Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 3010398 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on February 03, 2026

allot.subject: Preferential issue
allot.text: Issuance of 30,10,398 equity shares of the Company having a face value of Rs. 2 each at an issue price of Rs. 182.70 per equity shares (including premium), by way of preferential issue to non-promoters, subject to receipt of necessary regulatory and statutory approvals, as may be required.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. Thursday, December 18, 2025, inter-alia, considered and approved the following: i) the expansion of facilities for the manufacture of liquid cooling skids for Data centers. ii) the installation of robotic welding lines and automatic welding stations for manufacturing assemblies of flexible stainless-steel hoses. iii) the setting up of an annealing plant for stainless-steel braided hoses and assemblies for mission critical applications and other requirements as decided by the Management. iv) issuance
